themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, welfare, and employment. This theme reflects a shared rhetorical and legislative strategy to appeal to nationalist sentiments and address voter concerns about immigration and resource allocation.
